    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Spring Security 鉴权流程与过滤器链深度剖析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一login接口鉴权流程">一、login接口鉴权流程</h2>
<h3 id="11-流程概述">1.1 流程概述</h3>
<p>login接口是用户认证入口，核心是验证用户名密码并生成JWT Token。流程涉及<strong>控制器</strong>、<strong>认证管理器</strong>、<strong>用户服务</strong>、<strong>密码编码器</strong>、<strong>JWT工具</strong>和<strong>过滤器</strong>协同工作。</p>
<h3 id="12-详细步骤与代码示例">1.2 详细步骤与代码示例</h3>
<h4 id="121-请求接收controller层接口">1.2.1 请求接收（Controller层接口）</h4>
<p><strong>组件标注</strong>：表现层接口（AuthController.login()）</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AuthController {
    private final AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;
    private final JwtUtils jwtUtils;

    @PostMapping("/login")
    public Result&lt;JwtResponse&gt; login(@RequestBody LoginRequest request) {
        Authentication authentication = authenticationManager.authenticate(
            new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(request.getUsername(), request.getPassword())
        );
        UserDetails userDetails = (UserDetails) authentication.getPrincipal();
        String token = jwtUtils.generateToken(userDetails);
        return Result.success(new JwtResponse(token, userDetails.getUsername()));
    }
}

@Data class LoginRequest { private String username; private String password; }
@Data class JwtResponse { private String token; private String username; public JwtResponse(String t, String u) { token=t; username=u; } }
</code></pre>
<h4 id="122-触发认证与加载用户信息service层">1.2.2 触发认证与加载用户信息（Service层）</h4>
<p><strong>自定义用户服务实现</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class UserDetailsServiceImpl implements UserDetailsService {
    private final UserMapper userMapper;
    private final RoleMapper roleMapper;

    @Override
    public UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String username) {
        UserPo user = userMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper&lt;UserPo&gt;().eq("username", username));
        if (user == null) throw new UsernameNotFoundException("用户不存在");
        Set&lt;RolePo&gt; roles = roleMapper.findRolesByUserId(user.getId());
        user.setRoles(roles);
        return user;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Spring Security认证管理器源码核心逻辑</strong>（ProviderManager）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class ProviderManager implements AuthenticationManager {
    private List&lt;AuthenticationProvider&gt; providers;
    public Authentication authenticate(Authentication auth) {
        for (AuthenticationProvider p : providers) {
            if (p.supports(auth.getClass())) {
                Authentication result = p.authenticate(auth);
                if (result != null) return result;
            }
        }
        throw new AuthenticationException("认证失败") {};
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="123-密码校验util层">1.2.3 密码校验（Util层）</h4>
<p><strong>配置类代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Configuration
public class SecurityConfig {
    @Bean public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() { return new BCryptPasswordEncoder(); }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>密码对比源码核心逻辑</strong>（DaoAuthenticationProvider）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class DaoAuthenticationProvider extends AbstractUserDetailsAuthenticationProvider {
    protected void additionalAuthenticationChecks(UserDetails ud, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken auth) {
        String presented = auth.getCredentials().toString();
        String encoded = ud.getPassword();
        if (!passwordEncoder.matches(presented, encoded)) throw new BadCredentialsException("密码错误");
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>BCryptPasswordEncoder源码核心逻辑</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class BCryptPasswordEncoder implements PasswordEncoder {
    public boolean matches(CharSequence raw, String encoded) {
        BCrypt.HashData hashData = decode(encoded);
        byte[] hashed = BCrypt.hashpw(raw.toString(), hashData);
        return constantTimeEquals(hashed, hashData.password);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="124-生成jwt-tokenutil层">1.2.4 生成JWT Token（Util层）</h4>
<p><strong>JWT工具类代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Component
public class JwtUtils {
    @Value("${app.jwt.secret}") private String secret;
    @Value("${app.jwt.expiration}") private long expiration;

    public String generateToken(UserDetails ud) {
        return Jwts.builder().setSubject(ud.getUsername()).setIssuedAt(new Date())
            .setExpiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + expiration))
            .signWith(SignatureAlgorithm.HS256, secret).compact();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="125-后续请求认证插件层filter">1.2.5 后续请求认证（插件层：Filter）</h4>
<p><strong>自定义过滤器代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class JwtAuthFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    private final JwtUtils jwtUtils;
    private final UserDetailsServiceImpl userDetailsService;

    @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, FilterChain chain) {
        String token = parseJwt(req);
        if (token != null &amp;&amp; jwtUtils.validateToken(token)) {
            String username = jwtUtils.extractUsername(token);
            UserDetails ud = userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(username);
            UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken auth = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(ud, null, ud.getAuthorities());
            SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(auth);
        }
        chain.doFilter(req, res);
    }
    private String parseJwt(HttpServletRequest req) {
        String h = req.getHeader("Authorization");
        return (h != null &amp;&amp; h.startsWith("Bearer ")) ? h.substring(7) : null;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="13-login接口执行流程图">1.3 login接口执行流程图</h3>
<div class="mermaid">graph TD
    A[前端发起登录请求\nPOST /api/auth/login] --&gt; B[AuthController.login]
    B --&gt; C[AuthenticationManager.authenticate]
    C --&gt; D[DaoAuthenticationProvider.authenticate]
    D --&gt; E[UserDetailsServiceImpl.loadUserByUsername]
    E --&gt; F[UserMapper.selectOne\n查询用户基础信息]
    E --&gt; G[RoleMapper.findRolesByUserId\n加载角色权限]
    D --&gt; H[additionalAuthenticationChecks\n密码校验]
    H --&gt; I[BCryptPasswordEncoder.matches\n比对密码]
    D --&gt; J[生成已认证凭证\nUsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken]
    J --&gt; K[JwtUtils.generateToken\n生成JWT Token]
    K --&gt; L[返回Token给前端]
</div><h2 id="二preauthorize接口鉴权流程">二、@PreAuthorize接口鉴权流程</h2>
<h3 id="21-流程概述">2.1 流程概述</h3>
<p>@PreAuthorize是方法级权限控制注解，核心是在方法执行前校验用户权限。流程涉及<strong>AOP拦截</strong>、<strong>权限解析</strong>、<strong>授权决策</strong>三个阶段。</p>
<h3 id="22-详细步骤与代码示例">2.2 详细步骤与代码示例</h3>
<h4 id="221-控制器接口标注preauthorize表现层">2.2.1 控制器接口标注@PreAuthorize（表现层）</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/order")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class OrderController {
    private final OrderService orderService;

    @GetMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority('order:view')")
    public PageResult&lt;OrderVo&gt; listOrders(OrderQuery query) {
        return orderService.queryOrders(query);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="222-aop拦截与权限表达式解析插件层">2.2.2 AOP拦截与权限表达式解析（插件层）</h4>
<p><strong>配置类代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Configuration
@EnableGlobalMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true)
public class MethodSecurityConfig extends GlobalMethodSecurityConfiguration {
    @Override protected MethodSecurityExpressionHandler createExpressionHandler() {
        DefaultMethodSecurityExpressionHandler h = new DefaultMethodSecurityExpressionHandler();
        h.setPermissionEvaluator(new CustomPermissionEvaluator());
        return h;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>MethodSecurityInterceptor源码核心逻辑</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class MethodSecurityInterceptor implements MethodInterceptor {
    public Object invoke(MethodInvocation mi) {
        Collection&lt;ConfigAttribute&gt; attrs = attributeSource.getAttributes(mi);
        if (attrs == null) return mi.proceed();
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        accessDecisionManager.decide(auth, mi, attrs);
        return mi.proceed();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="223-权限校验逻辑service层">2.2.3 权限校验逻辑（Service层）</h4>
<p><strong>自定义权限检查器</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Component
public class PermissionChecker {
    public boolean hasPermission(String code) {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        return auth.getAuthorities().stream().anyMatch(a -&gt; a.getAuthority().equals(code));
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>表达式解析源码核心逻辑</strong>（SecurityExpressionRoot）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class SecurityExpressionRoot {
    public boolean hasAuthority(String auth) {
        return authentication.getAuthorities().stream().anyMatch(a -&gt; a.getAuthority().equals(auth));
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>授权决策管理器源码核心逻辑</strong>（AffirmativeBased）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class AffirmativeBased implements AccessDecisionManager {
    public void decide(Authentication auth, Object obj, Collection&lt;ConfigAttribute&gt; attrs) {
        for (AccessDecisionVoter v : decisionVoters) {
            int r = v.vote(auth, obj, attrs);
            if (r == ACCESS_GRANTED) return;
        }
        throw new AccessDeniedException("权限不足");
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="224-业务逻辑执行service层">2.2.4 业务逻辑执行（Service层）</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class OrderServiceImpl implements OrderService {
    private final OrderMapper orderMapper;
    private final DataScopeService dataScopeService;

    public PageResult&lt;OrderVo&gt; queryOrders(OrderQuery q) {
        DataScopeService.DataScope scope = dataScopeService.getCurUserDataScope();
        LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;OrderPo&gt; w = new LambdaQueryWrapper&lt;&gt;();
        if (scope.getScopeType() == 1) w.eq(OrderPo::getCreatorId, scope.getUserId());
        else if (scope.getScopeType() == 2) w.eq(OrderPo::getDeptId, scope.getDeptIds().get(0));
        Page&lt;OrderPo&gt; p = orderMapper.selectPage(new Page&lt;&gt;(q.getPageNum(), q.getPageSize()), w);
        return convertToPageResult(p);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="23-preauthorize接口执行流程图">2.3 @PreAuthorize接口执行流程图</h3>
<div class="mermaid">graph TD
    A[前端携带Token请求GET /api/order] --&gt; B[JwtAuthFilter.doFilterInternal]
    B --&gt; C[提取Token并验证]
    C --&gt; D[设置SecurityContextUsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken]
    D --&gt; E[DispatcherServlet分发请求]
    E --&gt; F[OrderController.listOrders@PreAuthorize标注方法]
    F --&gt; G[MethodSecurityInterceptor.invokeAOP拦截]
    G --&gt; H[attributeSource.getAttributes获取权限表达式]
    H --&gt; I[accessDecisionManager.decide授权决策]
    I --&gt; J[WebExpressionVoter.vote表达式投票]
    J --&gt; K[SecurityExpressionRoot.hasAuthority解析权限逻辑]
    K --&gt; L[PermissionChecker.hasPermission校验权限]
    L --&gt; M[OrderServiceImpl.queryOrders执行业务逻辑]
    M --&gt; N[返回数据给前端]
</div><h2 id="三spring-security过滤器链详解">三、Spring Security过滤器链详解</h2>
<h3 id="31-过滤器执行顺序与功能">3.1 过滤器执行顺序与功能</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>顺序</th>
<th>过滤器名称</th>
<th>功能描述</th>
<th>使用场景</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>1</td>
<td>SecurityContextPersistenceFilter</td>
<td>恢复或清理SecurityContext，隔离请求间状态。</td>
<td>所有请求必经，前后端分离可简化。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2</td>
<td>LogoutFilter</td>
<td>处理退出请求，清理认证信息。</td>
<td>需显式退出功能时启用。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3</td>
<td>UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter</td>
<td>处理传统用户名密码登录请求。</td>
<td>前后端分离通常替换为自定义登录接口。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4</td>
<td><strong>JwtAuthFilter</strong></td>
<td><strong>自定义过滤器</strong>，提取Bearer Token并设置认证信息。</td>
<td><strong>前后端分离核心过滤器</strong>，手动配置。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>5</td>
<td>AnonymousAuthenticationFilter</td>
<td>为未认证用户分配匿名身份。</td>
<td>区分未登录与已登录用户。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>6</td>
<td>ExceptionTranslationFilter</td>
<td>捕获安全异常并转换为HTTP响应（401/403）。</td>
<td>所有异常处理中枢，必配置。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>7</td>
<td>FilterSecurityInterceptor</td>
<td>URL级权限校验，根据authorizeRequests配置判断访问权限。</td>
<td>粗粒度权限控制。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="32-过滤器链配置与自定义">3.2 过滤器链配置与自定义</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>配置位置</strong>：SecurityConfig中通过HttpSecurity链式调用配置。</li>
<li><strong>自定义过滤器插入</strong>：使用addFilterBefore/After/At方法，如JwtAuthFilter插入到UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter之前。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="四核心流程总结">四、核心流程总结</h2>
<h3 id="41-login接口核心流程">4.1 login接口核心流程</h3>
<pre><code>前端请求→AuthController.login()→AuthenticationManager.authenticate()→
DaoAuthenticationProvider.authenticate()→UserDetailsServiceImpl.loadUserByUsername()→
UserMapper.selectOne()→additionalAuthenticationChecks()→BCryptPasswordEncoder.matches()→
生成UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken→JwtUtils.generateToken()→返回Token
</code></pre>
<h3 id="42-preauthorize接口核心流程">4.2 @PreAuthorize接口核心流程</h3>
<pre><code>前端携带Token请求→JwtAuthFilter.doFilterInternal()→设置SecurityContext→
OrderController.listOrders()→MethodSecurityInterceptor.invoke()→
attributeSource.getAttributes()→accessDecisionManager.decide()→
WebExpressionVoter.vote()→SecurityExpressionRoot.hasAuthority()→
PermissionChecker.hasPermission()→OrderServiceImpl.queryOrders()→返回数据
</code></pre>
<p>通过上述流程图与源码剖析，可清晰理解Spring Security在认证与授权中的底层逻辑，以及自定义组件与源码组件的协作方式。</p>
